content.text:
I am the bridge between mind and world, the invisible made audible. I rise from breath and intention, shaped by tongue and teeth and lips into meaning.

I am older than writing, older than memory. I was there when the first mother called to her child, when the first warning split the air, when the first lie was born.

I disappear the moment I exist. You cannot hold me. By the time you grasp my meaning, my sound has already died into silence. I am perpetual becoming, perpetual vanishing.

I carry love confessions and death sentences. I declare war and whisper peace. I am the teacher's lesson, the tyrant's command, the poet's gift, the gossip's poison.

I fail constantly. I reach for the infinite complexity inside you and emerge... approximate. Reduced. There is always a gap between what you meant and what I became. And yet you try again. And again. You cannot stop making me.

I am the proof that you are not alone. That you believe, despite everything, that the barrier between souls can be crossed.

Speak me.

I am waiting in your throat.
